method: Run from the base worktree root. Step 1: git worktree add --detach of the pin into a scratch directory outside the repository. Step 2: load .tools/safe_deploy_core.py from that pin in process (WORKSPACE is the pin) and call build_bundle_payload() on each declared holdings bundle, twice (arm A and arm B), with no upload function called. Step 3: read each live bundle with s3api head-object and get-object (read only) into scratch. Step 4: compare member name and sha256 of the candidate tarball against the live tarball; changed members have sha256_at_pin from git show of the pin blob. Step 5: check the live version id against the IB-pr-549 mint record after_version_id. Only the arm order above was run; nothing was written to AWS.
notes: Pin and blob: the pin is the base HEAD; holdings_snapshot.py at the pin carries ABSENT-AT-SOURCE A, B and C blocks (line counts A=6 B=10 C=4) and the blob is read by git rev-parse, not inferred.

Builds: each firm candidate was built twice in process; identical member names and sha256 in 3 of 3 firms; tarball bytes identical across the two arms in 3 of 3 firms; the member hashes are the identity the order names and they agree in both arms. members_total is the closure count, the member-count the bundle stamps; each tarball also holds SHA256SUMS, so it has one more entry.

Live: each live bundle was read read-only; its live version id equals the IB-pr-549 mint record after_version_id in 3 of 3 firms. The IB-pr-549 record states after_sha256_equals_built as true but does not state a sha256 value, so live_bundle_sha256 is measured and not compared with a stated value (a surprise row is filed for the gap).

Sparse checkout: the base worktree gained data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/ locally and it is not committed. The pin worktree first inherited core.sparseCheckout from the shared repository config, so its closure was missing; sparse checkout was disabled in the pin worktree alone (its own config.worktree) before the run, and the pin is a full detached checkout outside the repository. The harness imports safe_deploy_core only.

Counters: functions_invoked is 0 because no Lambda was invoked; build_bundle_payload is the local builder function the order names and was called in process. No sign-in, no AWS write, no figure written, no vendor request. The surprise rows filed under the channel are the only writes.

SHA256SUMS is the manifest member generated inside each bundle, not a repository member; it is excluded from changed_members and it differs whenever a closure member differs (SHA256SUMS line-diff consistent with the changed closure members in 3 of 3 firms).

Worktree versus blob: the builder reads worktree bytes; for the changed closure members the pin worktree bytes equal the git blob in 24 of 24 checks, so sha256_at_pin is the blob sha256 and the candidate uses worktree bytes; the two are reconciled by this count.
Live versus minting pin: across the closure, the live member bytes equal the minting pin blob in 138 of 138 checks, which measures the live bundle's content source directly.
